acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01 must reject worlds where target answer/current state/identifier features predict held-out action labels, where a single episode solves the target, or where continuation/cloning cannot separate prior experience from later target action. AT02 establishes only eligible action-outcome atoms and locally supported procedures enter a reset-isolated per-life corpus; fidelity, directional failures, uncertainty, and shortcut provenance are prerequisites rather than action evidence. AT03 is the decisive representation/use attribution: same ordered lived deck, cleared context/cache, frozen snapshot, equal action/thought/retrieval/context/adapter-byte/consolidation budgets, and sealed read-only evaluation prevent raw context, cache, unequal experience, or evaluation feedback from bypassing Dream→Compile→Memory→Think. AT04 must include strong native-long-context, raw RAG, organized linked text/GraphRAG/A-MEM, explicit graph/skill memory where feasible, direct/raw LoRA, identical compiled corpus in text and LoRA, sleep-text, no-memory, shuffled bindings/connectivity, cross-life adapter, recurrence-removal, shortcut-removal, scale/lifetime, and batch-SFT reference arms. It must show whether local dream edges accumulated across sleeps are necessary while goal-conditioned path construction occurs only at later wake time. AT05 may support action improvement only through blinded A2-A4 fresh goals whose exact solution is absent from any episode, commitment-before-outcome, counterfactual twins/rule changes, cited reconstruction paths, calibration, and correction metrics; A0/A1, reader fidelity, exact recall, dependency reconstruction, query cost, and action value remain distinct endpoints. AT06 may support online/flywheel evidence only after common-deck attribution: paired fixed-budget on-policy lives, hidden checkpoints, public outcome eligibility, action-information-gain accounting, and the cross-system experience/representation swap must isolate changed evidence collection from better use of an identical stream. AT07 blocks GPU headline/scientific use unless a fresh reviewer verifies source hashes, protocol/budget/split integrity, all declared baselines and negative cells, reset isolation, leakage absence, proper whole-world-life replication, and conclusion scope.

ambiguities.impact: Neither Level-1 world nor Level-2 target is selected, so target-only predictor features, reusable-structure criteria, rule-change protocol, cloning interface, and meaningful action-value normalization are not yet bound.
ambiguities.question: Which exact persistent world(s), target task distributions, public observation interface, and preregistered predictor floors will Rohin ratify after AT01?

ambiguities.impact: The proposal requires comparable budgets but does not specify whether fixed inference-active bytes, total retained bytes, adapter rank/bytes, retrieval tokens, training FLOPs, dream calls, controller tokens, or wall-clock are primary; text, graph, RAG, and LoRA can otherwise receive incomparable capacity.
ambiguities.question: Which exact resource ledger and matching rule—including native-long-context capacity and external-index size—will be preregistered?

ambiguities.impact: Practical margin, target-only floor, geometric checkpoint sample size, replication count, aggregation, multiple-comparison treatment, and definition of positive at two later checkpoints are deliberately unchosen, so C01/C03 cannot yet be adjudicated.
ambiguities.question: What margin, estimand, whole-world-life sample size, confidence procedure, and missing/checkpoint handling rule will be ratified?

ambiguities.impact: A strong organized text, GraphRAG, or explicit graph control can either be a legitimate bounded memory interface or an answer-bearing solver; the proposal states the audit graph is non-cognitive but does not fully bind permitted cognitive access for external-memory controls.
ambiguities.question: What common retrieval/query API and provenance-only restrictions will ensure text/graph controls are strong without exposing hidden target paths or giving cognition a privileged solver?

ambiguities.impact: The proposal names tested hot-path shortcuts and recurrent local growth, but does not bind which shortcut materializations are permitted, how shuffled connectivity differs from shuffled action-outcome bindings, or whether recurrence-removal receives equivalent batch compute.
ambiguities.question: What exact corpus transformations and compute-matched recurrence/batch controls will be frozen?

assumptions: A later held-out goal may reveal its public goal text but not its answer, target branch outcome, evaluator label, exact solver output, or a target-derived feature unavailable during life.
The common deck contains the same chronological public action-observation-outcome stream for every arm and no arm's checkpoint result affects its later state or corpus.

All memory substrates are compared both under a fixed active inference-memory budget and with total retained-memory/training-compute quantities reported, pending human ratification of the primary comparison.

Local dream proposals can persist only through provenance-preserving compiled semantic memories and reset-isolated per-life artifacts; no uncompiled draft, cache, prior-life state, or shared MEMORY adapter is usable at later wake.
A positive action effect is not evidence of parametric transport unless the same accepted corpus and read plan are compared against bounded text and organized external-memory conditions.
claim_delta_interpretation: C01 is conditional and demands sustained post-context A2-A4 action advantage over the strongest matched organized external-memory control, not an early gain, raw recall, or a single endpoint. C02 correctly assigns LoRA only lossy per-life associative persistence/access; explicit tokens/workspace reconstruct multi-hop paths and dream/compiler stages propose and materialize local structure. C03 requires observed, preregistered crossover evidence rather than assuming baseline saturation; early text/RAG superiority and non-monotonicity are compatible with the hypothesis. C04 requires a distinct on-policy causal experiment because fixed-deck results can establish memory transport/composition/use but cannot establish improved experience collection. C05 requires preservation and reporting of nulls: target-only prediction, fixed-deck disappearance, shuffle/cross-life insensitivity, A0/A1-only gains, no recurrence or shortcut benefit, resource mismatch, and unresolved false-memory drift each narrow or reject the headline.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, bind a common external-memory interface and two explicit budget analyses: equal active decision-time memory and reported total retained/training resource; require the identical accepted corpus and matched reader/controller protocol for text, graph, and LoRA.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal correctly acknowledges that recognition/read protocol can dominate at small memory, but the present generic budget language does not by itself prevent either an underpowered text/graph control or an over-capacious adapter. Without this binding, a post-context difference is not uniquely attributable to per-life parametric transport.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed benchmark does not yet force a fair fixed-memory text-versus-LoRA conclusion.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: For every A2-A4 target family, preregister paired worlds with matching public superficial signatures but distinct causal rules/actions, and report target-only/current-state/identifier predictor performance per split and checkpoint.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: AT01 and AT05 require shortcut audits, but a global predictor floor can miss family- or checkpoint-specific target decoding. Counterfactual pairing is necessary to demonstrate that cross-episode causal evidence, rather than target appearance or action priors, supplies later action value.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A generic leakage audit alone is insufficient to establish that the proposed game forces the intended experiential path.

graph_delta_interpretation: The graph establishes a full temporal organism: public action creates immutable episodic evidence; wake obtains bounded exact support and adapter-associated candidates; a scheduler selects public traces and a non-evidentiary agenda; dream locally proposes relations/procedures/exceptions/shortcuts; compiler preserves status and provenance while creating a transport corpus; a per-life clean-base-rebuilt LoRA supplies only associative candidates; wake explicitly reconstructs a cited path and acts. Audit/offline scorer are reporting-only, while frozen snapshots feed sealed evaluators. The benchmark must demonstrate that no direct episodic lookup, raw transcript/RAG, explicit graph, answer prior, target decoder, current-state feature, cache, or cross-life artifact can bypass the local-growth→compiler→memory→goal-conditioned reconstruction pathway.

open_questions: Rohin must ratify exact architecture bytes and permitted implementation scope.
Rohin must select the primary benchmark/environment and bind its world generator, splits, target families, and continuation protocol.
Rohin must set practical margin, predictor floors, resource budgets, geometric schedule, baseline implementations, and statistical decision rules.
No implementation, benchmark selection, experiment, GPU run, or scientific claim is authorized by this interpretation.

loop_delta_interpretation: L01 separates action and later public outcome from reasoning: wake commits a cited prediction/plan before the environment returns evidence. L02 occurs only at declared sleep checkpoints and may turn prior eligible public traces plus a non-evidentiary frontier into local, status-typed semantic connections, then rebuild the per-life adapter from clean base. L03 freezes the representation, clears transient state, and discards held-out evaluation outcomes, so it measures transport/reconstruction/action use of a common history rather than exploration or feedback. L04 is separately needed to test whether memory changes information-seeking actions, later public evidence, subsequent dreams, and later action; swaps distinguish experience quality from representation quality. L05 is future-only and cannot leak a learned controller or shared MEMORY state into an evaluation life.
system_thesis_interpretation: The intended organism is not a memory-answer benchmark. It is a fixed pretrained controller living in a partially observed causal world: it acts and receives public outcomes; preserves exact episodes; periodically dreams over selected, provenance-limited traces to add local semantic/procedural relations, exceptions, and tested shortcuts; compiles those into a reset-isolated per-life LoRA; then uses LoRA associations plus bounded episodic support to explicitly construct a goal-conditioned dependency path only when a later action needs it. The benchmark must demonstrate continued improvement after raw history exceeds working context, while stronger episodic/linked/graph/parametric alternatives flatten under matched resources; only a separately isolated on-policy experiment can show the full feedback flywheel.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract supports causal interpretation only if enforced mechanically. Wake may see current public state/goal, bounded retrieved lived traces, compiled status-typed memories, and adapter reads; it must not see held-out answers/outcomes, offline truth/solver, checkpoint labels, prior-life MEMORY/episodic/cache state, uncompiled dream drafts, or an answer-bearing audit graph. Sleep may see eligible public traces, typed agenda, and prior semantic status, but never held-out targets, evaluation labels, or solver truth. Compile may materialize only evidence-cited public content. Offline scoring can use truth only after commitment and cannot steer any cognitive choice. Checkpoint evaluation can access frozen memory and hidden truth internally but must emit sealed metrics and restore no state or feedback to life.
